# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by `rustcms docs:cli`; do not edit. -->

`rustcms` creates applications and generates code. Other commands run inside the
application in the current directory (`cargo run -- <command>`).

## Global commands

### `new`

Create a new application

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<name>` | Package name (lowercase letters, digits, `-` and `_`) |
| `--path` | Parent directory (default: `.`) |
| `--rustcms-path` | Use a local rustcms checkout instead of crates.io (written verbatim, relative to the new app) |
| `--in-workspace` | Do not declare a standalone `[workspace]` (for apps inside another workspace) |

### `make:model`

Create a SeaORM entity in `src/models`

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<name>` | Model name in PascalCase, e.g. `BlogPost` |
| `-m, --migration` | Also create a `create_<table>_table` migration |

### `make:migration`

Create a migration in `src/migrations`

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<name>` | snake_case name; `create_<table>_table` generates a table skeleton |

### `docs:cli`

Print the command reference as Markdown

## Application commands

### `serve`

Start the HTTP server

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--listen` | Address to listen on (default: `app.listen`) |

### `migrate`

Run pending migrations

### `migrate:rollback`

Roll back the last migrations

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--step` | Number of migrations to roll back (default: `1`) |

### `migrate:fresh`

Drop all tables and re-run every migration

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--force` | Required in production |

### `migrate:refresh`

Roll back every migration and run them again

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--force` | Required in production |

### `migrate:status`

Show applied and pending migrations

### `key:generate`

Generate APP_KEY and write it to .env

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `--show` | Print the key instead of writing .env |
| `--force` | Replace an existing APP_KEY |
